name: selection-toolbar
title: Selection Toolbar
description: A floating formatting bar that appears whenever text is selected inside an editable area. It offers bold, italic, link, copy and share actions, follows the selection and stays inside the viewport.
use: Editable article text needs quick bold, link, copy and share actions right where the user selected something.
avoid: It watches one container via the browser selection API, so shadow DOM or cross-node selections can misplace it.
a11y: The bar is labelled and Escape closes it, but it opens only from a mouse selection and its icon buttons carry no individual labels. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A dark, rounded editor card holds a white heading and two grey paragraphs of body text. Selected words get a translucent highlight, and a compact dark strip of five small line icons appears above, with a thin divider after the first three.
behaves: Selecting text inside the card opens a small toolbar just above the highlight; it flips and shifts to stay on screen and closes on Escape, a click elsewhere or when the selection clears. The icons act on the chosen words.
customise: Placement side, offsets, collision handling, open state, selection callback and the container are props; the action buttons are composed as children and their behaviour is yours.
weight: light: A tiny floating strip of five buttons; work happens only on selection events.
